question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e910d14b879e7825476fb5b34a647809ace85a039c1d85fe07143097c8a88a1.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The number of shaded squares in the rhombus element are increasing subsequently.

2) The number of shaded squares at the bottom are increasing subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c64976f3eb2bc74f9734acab43af464e7968352a05b09023323d5b64367d5036.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23307c6b0886ae5708f094e106844c35dc12bb24f649079af8b6f1bb13726b7c.png] 

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
